title: Concept: TeamCity console is reachable without authentication
description: TeamCity is a build orchestrator: build steps are code, VCS roots carry credentials and artifacts are the deployable output. A public interface exposes the build topology, and an unconfigured instance lets the first visitor create the administrator.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller takes the administrator account on an unconfigured server or, with guest access, reads build logs and artifact listings that name internal hosts.
